intent: Create a 16:9 horizontal overhead light-table research photograph of a familiar steel coffee spoon and its corresponding translucent graphite study. A continuous clean opal-white diffuser fills the canvas; physical construction, clear visual hierarchy and paper transmission are the visible goals.

content_scope.basis: This text-authored field example selects the spoon and its own contour and surface studies within the default subject-study scope.

decisions.subject_basis: One familiar unbranded stainless-steel demitasse coffee spoon, approximately 120 mm long: a conventional shallow oval bowl, smooth continuous rounded rim, a naturally tapered narrow neck and one slim straight handle ending in a softly rounded tip. The bowl is visibly hollow and faces upward. The handle is gently curved in elevation while its plan-view centerline remains straight. The spoon is one continuous formed metal utensil with a polished bowl and a subtly satin-finished handle, a consistent thin rim and ordinary usable proportions.

scene.support: The listed objects have the ordinary material thickness and stable contacts of their recognizable product type. design.materials: The spoon is credible formed stainless steel: a smooth shallow hollow bowl with a continuous thin rounded rim, a gradual neck transition and a slim satin handle. A broad neutral reflection sweeps through the concave bowl and a darker neighboring reflection makes its depth legible; the fine brushed handle keeps subtle directional texture. Two tracing-paper sheets have delicate fibers, clean thin edges and geometric graphite drawings. The upper sheet attenuates and softens lower graphite only within the actual overlap. The warm-white diffusing tabletop stays clean and smooth, with short soft shadows at the actual spoon and paper contact points. The horizontal softbox light-table has a smooth opal-white diffusing top lit evenly from within. Its exposed surface has a warm neutral luminous value, each single tracing-paper layer slightly attenuates the transmitted light, and the overlapping region has a clearly legible gentle step in optical density. Keep broad diffuse light, realistic exposure, local contact shading and graphite detail simultaneously visible.
design.palette: A controlled neutral palette: luminous warm-white tabletop, pale translucent paper, graphite and the stated authentic product colors. Reflection brightness and material density set a clear primary and secondary hierarchy. Color accents, when specified, stay on their stated materials.

photography.focus_and_depth: Keep the recognizable subject structure, required material edges and corresponding paper study readable at delivery size. The main subject has a crisp coherent silhouette; scattering through covering paper explains the softer covered graphite.
photography.visible_result: A recognizable real coffee spoon, a precise related graphite contour and an explicit paper transmission comparison on a clean continuous opal light-table surface.
photography.lighting_setup: The large horizontal softbox-table emits even warm-neutral 5000 K diffused light from beneath the opal tabletop. The lower sheet, small upper overlay and exposed diffuser retain three subtly distinct transmission values. A gentle broad overhead-left diffusion reflection reveals the steel spoon bowl and satin handle. Keep the transmitted surface as the dominant environmental light; preserve the covered graphite rather than bleaching it.
photography.exposure_intent: Expose the opal tabletop below clipping, keeping subtle paper fibers, denser overlap, both exposed and softened covered graphite, and the opaque spoon clearly visible.
